name: 071-ocr-layout-report
description: Rendered full-page layout: Single-column numbered report with bullet metrics. Scored as raw CER and as markup-neutral CER (the gating number). Classical gates require the tessdata_best eng.traineddata cache (NV_OCR_TESSDATA); model gates require DeepSeek-OCR weights.
expected_text:
Quarterly Engineering Report
Q2 2026 - Platform Infrastructure Team
1. Summary
Service availability held at 99.97% across all regions this quarter.
The migration to the new scheduler completed two weeks ahead of plan.
2. Key Metrics
- Median API latency: 41 ms (down from 58 ms)
- Error budget consumed: 22 percent
- Deployments per week: 134
- Mean time to recovery: 11 minutes
3. Incidents
Two SEV-2 incidents occurred in May, both traced to a faulty rollout of
the connection pooler. A full postmortem is linked in the appendix.
4. Next Quarter
We will pilot zonal failover drills and finish the IPv6 rollout.
Prepared by: R. Alvarez, approved by the infrastructure steering group.

scoring.raw: character edit distance against expected_text verbatim
scoring.neutral: same distance after nv-ocr tests/markup_neutral.rs::markup_neutral (port of real5/score.py::strip_markup + whitespace collapse); this is the gating number

notes: single-column numbered report with bullet metrics
